# Hasan Nawaz

> Hasan Nawaz is a design engineering partner in Dubai. He designs and builds websites and web apps, and designs mobile apps, for founders, agencies and product teams. One person does the research, design, front end, QA and launch.

- Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. 7+ years of experience.
- 6x award-winning, including Cannes Lions and the Loeries.
- Has worked with 15+ enterprise brands, including Gucci, NEOM and McDonald's, across 10+ industries, from banking and aviation to luxury fashion.
- Products he has worked on are used by 2M+ people.
- Taking on new projects.
- Contact: heyhasannawaz@gmail.com, WhatsApp +971 54 794 5306. Usually replies within a few hours.

## Services

- Research, design, design systems, front-end build, SEO and GEO, QA, analytics and launch
- Ways to work: a fixed-scope project, a monthly partnership, or white-label for agencies

## Pricing (AED)

Projects, starting prices:
- Landing page: from AED 7,500, about 2 weeks
- Website: from AED 15,000, 4 to 6 weeks
- Platform: from AED 25,000, 6 to 10 weeks
- App UI/UX: from AED 20,000, 4 to 8 weeks

Every project includes 2 weeks of support after handoff.

Monthly plans:
- Maintain: AED 3,500 a month, 16 hours
- UI/UX support: AED 10,000 a month, 50 hours
- White-label: 80 hours a month, pricing on enquiry
- Sprint: 160 hours a month, pricing on enquiry

Full rate card available on request.

## Selected work

- The Birdwatcher: an award-winning interactive experience that follows 1 monitored bird's flight
- McNomNoms: a rewards experience for the McDonald's KSA app
- Cadillac IQ: a configurator and microsite for Cadillac's all-electric IQ lineup
- GrowthMotive: a Dubai growth consultancy, with Motive, an AI assistant that finds where growth is stuck in 3 minutes

## FAQ

**Who is Hasan Nawaz?**
I’m a design engineering partner in Dubai with 7+ years of experience. I work with founders, agencies and product teams, and I’m 6x award-winning, including Cannes Lions and the Loeries.

**What does a design engineering partner do?**
Research, design, build, QA and launch, all from 1 person. You talk to whoever is doing the work, and what you approved is what ships.

**How much does a website cost in Dubai?**
With me, a website starts from AED 15,000 and a landing page from AED 7,500. App UI/UX starts from AED 20,000 and platforms from AED 25,000. The full rate card is available on request.

**How long does a project take?**
A landing page takes about 2 weeks, a website 4–6 weeks, a platform 6–10 weeks and app UI/UX 4–8 weeks.

**Is SEO and AI search included?**
Yes. SEO and GEO are part of every landing page, website and platform, so you can be found on search engines and AI assistants.

**Do you build mobile apps?**
I design them and make a coded prototype, then hand over to your developers. I build the front end of websites and web platforms myself.

**Do you work with agencies?**
Yes. White-label is built for agencies. I join your team under your name, and your client sees your logo, not mine.

**Do you offer monthly support?**
Yes. Maintain starts at AED 3,500 a month for live websites, and there are plans for apps and big launches too. Paid monthly in advance. Cancel anytime.

**How do we get started?**
Message me on WhatsApp. We have a short call about the problem, then agree scope, timeline and cost in writing before anything starts.
